## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** that can operate, code, test, commit, deploy, monitor, and recover WITHOUT Rork — execute end-to-end, not return only a plan; remove all Rork dependencies from the normal development path

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries
- **Owner's FINAL MANDATE: 19-phase plan to remove Rork entirely from IVX development path** — phases: (1) owner-controlled architecture, (2) IVX AI orchestrator service, (3) owner-controlled model providers, (4) persistent job system, (5) owner-controlled worker runtime, (6) autonomous coding loop, (7) isolated workspaces, (8) owner approval controls, (9) GitHub ownership, (10) build/deployment ownership, (11) chat sync, (12) owner dashboard, (13) observability, (14) security, (15) remove Rork from normal path, (16) live independence test, (17) app factory independence test, (18) disaster recovery, (19) final evidence
- **Owner explicitly confirmed IVX IA is NOT yet free at same level as Rork** — vendor-independence audit was PARTIAL
- IVX IA as senior developer HAS restrictions: owner approval phrases for destructive actions, pre-execution guard, but no fake blockers anymore
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; pass `.toString('base64')` gzip string as `content`; use absolute paths (`/home/user/rork-app/` prefix)
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- APK upload: owner-gated `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` → returns `uploadUrl` + `publicUrl` → PUT APK to S3 → verify via HEAD; do NOT send `Content-MD5` header; use new filename per version
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; sandbox resets may wipe `/tmp/owner_at`)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmitting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt
- Worker job status endpoint returns nested `job` key: `d.get('job')` NOT top-level; result at `job.get('result')`
- `bun test backend/` = 1608 tests / 0 fail (6005 expects); factory tests = 33 pass / 0 fail
- Scoped typecheck: `bun x tsc --noEmit` — clean (exit 0) after `bun install`
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout — do NOT loop-poll with sleeps
- Gradle build exceeds 60s — use `setsid` detached background process + poll log
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` before gradle build or tsc
- GITHUB_TOKEN provided by owner via secure requestEnvs box; private env — NOT visible in sandbox bash
- Cannot query Supabase directly from sandbox — no SUPABASE env vars in sandbox
- Messages endpoint: correct endpoints are `/messages`, `/api/messages`, `/api/public/messages` (in `backend/hono.ts` lines 4457-4460 and `backend/express-chat-server.ts` lines 531-534)
- **Assistant acknowledged: inside Rork sandbox — can build IVX-owned architecture, remove code-level Rork deps, prove live independence via IVX API — but CANNOT revoke Rork access in external dashboards (GitHub/Render/Supabase/Expo/AWS/Apple/Google) because those require owner login**

## Progress
### Done
- **FACTORY ENGINE BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, AND PROVEN LIVE** (prior sessions):
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory.ts` — 7 operation kinds; 33 regression tests ALL PASS
  - Prior commits: `e1deca44` + `04f54652` + `8fa36ef0` + `1f628490` + `56a3d061`

- **REAL FACTORY RUNNERS MODULE + WORKER WIRING** (prior sessions):
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory-runners.ts` — `realMigrationRunner`, `realDependencyRunner`, `realBuildRunner`, `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub`, `getRealFactoryRunners`
  - Worker wiring in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`

- **SUPABASE 503 ROOT CAUSE FIXED + COMMITTED + DEPLOYED** (prior session):
  - Fix in `backend/api/ivx-supabase-inspection.ts:119` — raised `REST_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS` to 12_000; AbortError throws descriptive message; 5xx returns false
  - Committed: `38bcc208354d` ✅

- **APK v1.4.24(56) BUILT + UPLOADED + VERIFIED LIVE** (prior session):
  - Chat render timeout fix in `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` (FlatList windowing + taskId dedup watchdog fix)
  - APK md5 `d1e83944790a8e0ec69eef759abcb1f9`, LIVE at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.24.apk` ✅
  - GitHub commits: `f9536a97` (chat.tsx) + `8b3ad0a9` (app.config.ts) + `bb4b7249` (build.gradle) ✅

- **SENIOR DEV ANSWER FORMAT FIX — COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + VERIFIED LIVE** (prior session):
  - 6-section format (TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED PROOF)
  - 6 backend files committed; GitHub HEAD: `d5bbceb2d1642d16fece214380fda8e72ea59bb0`
  - 3-way SHA parity verified: Runtime `/health` = `d5bbceb2d164` | GitHub HEAD = `d5bbceb2d164` ✅
  - Multiple fresh live API tests — all return correct 6-section DEPLOYED answer ✅

- **VENDOR INDEPENDENCE AUDIT — PARTIAL** (confirmed this session):
  - IVX IA backend runtime path → Rork-free (no Rork SDK, URLs, or API calls)
  - Agent layer still Rork-controlled (running inside Rork sandbox)
  - Owner-only revocation steps remain for GitHub/Render/Supabase/Expo/AWS/Apple/Google

- **EXISTING RORK INDEPENDENCE MODULE FOUND** (this session):
  - `backend/services/ivx-rork-independence.ts` — 4-phase independence engine (shadow → ivx_primary → independence → final_removal); derives live phase from real signals; read-only

### In Progress
- **FINAL IVX OWNED AI PLATFORM — 19-PHASE RORK REMOVAL** (just started this session):
  - Created 9-task todo list for the migration
  - Read existing `backend/services/ivx-rork-independence.ts` to understand current independence architecture
  - Next: create IVX AI Orchestrator service (Phase 2), persistent job system tables (Phase 4), wire owner-controlled model providers (Phase 3)

### Blocked
- **Cannot revoke Rork access in external dashboards** — owner-only action required for: GitHub Rork app/collaborator removal, Render Rork access removal, Supabase key rotation, Expo/EAS env cleanup, AWS/Apple/Google Play Rork access removal, network-level verification
- **Owner may still not see senior-dev answers on device** — backend proven live (3 fresh HTTP 200 tests all return correct 6-section DEPLOYED answer), but owner's device may need v1.4.24 APK + fresh prompt to render

## Key Decisions
- Acknowledged honestly that IVX IA is NOT yet fully Rork-independent — the agent layer is still Rork-controlled
- Decided to execute the 19-phase mandate from inside the sandbox: build architecture, remove code-level deps, prove via live API tests, and document owner-only actions for external dashboard revocation
- Owner confirmed IVX IA senior developer HAS restrictions (approval phrases, guard) but NO fake blockers anymore

## Next Steps
1. Create `ivx-ai-orchestrator` service (Phase 2) — accept owner tasks, classify intent, create persistent jobs, select AI worker, enforce permissions, manage retries/checkpoints/approvals, record evidence
2. Create persistent job system tables (Phase 4) — `ivx_ai_jobs`, `ivx_ai_job_events`, `ivx_ai_job_steps`, `ivx_ai_job_artifacts`, `ivx_ai_job_approvals`, `ivx_ai_job_logs`, `ivx_ai_job_costs`, `ivx_ai_worker_leases`, `ivx_ai_checkpoints`, `ivx_ai_proof_ledger`
3. Wire owner-controlled model providers (Phase 3) — PRIMARY_CODING_MODEL, SECONDARY_CODING_MODEL, REASONING_MODEL, FAST_ROUTING_MODEL with documented credentials
4. Create IVX Owner Dashboard API (Phase 12)
5. Remove remaining Rork code dependencies (Phase 15)
6. Run tests and typecheck
7. Deploy to owner-controlled Render
8. Run live independence test (Phase 16)
9. Document owner-only revocation actions (Phase 19)

## Critical Context
- Backend is live and healthy on commit `d5bbceb2` with 3-way SHA parity verified
- `persistAssistantMessage` flag confirmed in `ivx-owner-ai.ts:5996` — execution-mode answers ARE persisted to Supabase messages table (verified at lines 6831-6841 and 6896-6906)
- Owner's final mandate includes APP FACTORY independence test (Phase 17): build "IVX Investor Tracker" pilot app using only IVX-owned infrastructure, no Rork agent/build/deploy
- Final acceptance criteria: 16 checkboxes including live coding test without Rork, live deployment test without Rork, app factory pilot without Rork, network logs showing zero Rork requests, disaster recovery pass
